hunks.baseline: A thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards marched in ranks, imperial flags flying overhead. Behind them came countless eunuchs and palace maids.
hunks.sol: A thousand Embroidered Uniform Guards marched in formation beneath fluttering imperial banners. Behind them came countless eunuchs and palace maids.

hunks.baseline: And at the center of it all was a magnificent, enormous imperial carriage, built for one person alone.
hunks.sol: At the center of the procession was an enormous, magnificent imperial carriage built for one person alone.

hunks.baseline: The powerful waves of qi they unleashed at the same time shook the air and washed over everyone’s skin.
hunks.sol: The powerful wave of qi they unleashed shook the air and washed over everyone’s skin.

hunks.baseline: Those who heard the voice slip between someone’s lips suddenly wondered:
hunks.sol: Those who heard the voice slip from someone’s lips suddenly wondered:

hunks.baseline: Who could that voice belong to?
hunks.sol: Who had said that?

hunks.baseline: From the enormous procession that had stopped at the Grand Banquet Hall, someone slowly rode forward on a fine steed and let out a thunderous cry.
hunks.sol: From the enormous procession that had come to a halt, someone slowly rode forward on a fine steed and let out a thunderous cry.

hunks.baseline: Not even the golden armor encasing his body or the helmet pulled low over his head could hide his truly overwhelming presence.
hunks.sol: Not even the golden armor encasing his body or the helmet pulled low over his head could hide his overwhelming presence.

hunks.baseline: At the shout, infused with internal energy, from Baek Yeon—the Emperor’s right hand in name and deed, and Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard—everyone in the Grand Banquet Hall rose and knelt.
hunks.sol: At the shout, infused with internal energy, from Baek Yeon—the Emperor’s right hand and Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard—everyone in the Grand Banquet Hall rose and knelt.

hunks.baseline: They moved as if they were one body, bowing their heads to the ruler of this vast continent.
hunks.sol: They moved as one, bowing their heads to the ruler of this vast continent.

hunks.baseline: At Ma Sanbao’s quiet murmur, everyone soon joined in.
hunks.sol: At Ma Sanbao’s quiet murmur, everyone joined in.

hunks.baseline: It was then.
At the very end of that resounding cheer, the Emperor stepped down from his sedan chair and walked slowly through the human curtain of guards.
hunks.sol: It was then, as that resounding cheer faded, that the Emperor stepped down from his sedan chair and walked slowly through the curtain of people.

hunks.baseline: But those who bowed their heads couldn’t see the Emperor as he passed them. Only after the empty seat on the throne atop the lofty stairs had finally been filled could they straighten up and face him.
hunks.sol: But with their heads bowed, they couldn’t see the Emperor as he passed. Only after he had taken his place on the throne atop the lofty stairs could they straighten up and face him.

hunks.baseline: The ruler of all under Heaven, who had shut himself away in Qianqing Palace for years on end while attending to the affairs of state.
hunks.sol: The ruler of all under Heaven, who had shut himself away in Qianqing Palace for years while attending to affairs of state.

hunks.baseline: And a man of tempestuous fortune, standing at the highest place beneath Heaven.
hunks.sol: And a man who had risen through turbulent times to stand at the highest place beneath Heaven.

hunks.baseline: In an instant, an unseen shock and disturbance swept across the Grand Banquet Hall like a wave.
hunks.sol: In an instant, shock and disquiet swept across the Grand Banquet Hall like an invisible wave.

hunks.baseline: Though he had aged beyond recognition, his eyes shone brighter than anyone else’s in the hall as he surveyed the gathered officials, great and small, one by one.
hunks.sol: Aged beyond recognition, but with eyes sharper than anyone else’s in the hall, he surveyed the gathered officials one by one.

hunks.baseline: The pillars that held up this vast empire. The very heart of the realm.
hunks.sol: The pillars that held up this vast empire. Its very heart.

hunks.baseline: Among them were generals who commanded armies, and old scholars with stooped backs but unbending eyes.
hunks.sol: Among them were generals who commanded armies, and old scholars whose backs were bent but whose eyes remained unbowed.

hunks.baseline: Their eyes met in midair.
hunks.sol: Their eyes met across the hall.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps it wasn’t just a few people who imagined it.
hunks.sol: Surely more than a few people heard it that way.

hunks.baseline: The atmosphere, frozen like a glacier, began to thaw little by little when musicians and dancers entered with an astonishing spread of delicacies and began to perform.
hunks.sol: The atmosphere, frozen like a glacier, began to thaw when musicians and dancers entered alongside an astonishing spread of delicacies and began to perform.

hunks.baseline: A melody that stirred the heart just to hear it, and sleeves fluttering in time with the music.
hunks.sol: The melody stirred the heart, and sleeves fluttered in time with the music.

hunks.baseline: It was only natural that those who’d nervously downed a cup of wine would feel at least a little more at ease.
hunks.sol: Perhaps it was only natural that those who’d had a drink to settle their nerves began to relax a little.

hunks.baseline: “Shut your mouth. You want to say something wrong and invite needless suspicion?”
hunks.sol: “Shut your mouth. You want to say the wrong thing and invite needless suspicion?”

hunks.baseline: I casually picked up a bite of food from the appetizer in front of me.
hunks.sol: I casually picked up a bite of food from the plate in front of me.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, I felt the middle-aged man across from me fixing me with an unusually persistent stare.
hunks.sol: The next moment, I felt the middle-aged man across from me fix me with an unusually persistent stare.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the young official’s voice reached my ears.
hunks.sol: The young official’s voice reached my ears, too.

hunks.baseline: The hall being used for today’s grand banquet was large enough to hold training for thousands of soldiers at once. For that reason, the officials seated at regular intervals were also quite far apart.
hunks.sol: The hall being used for today’s grand banquet was large enough to train thousands of soldiers at once. The officials, seated at regular intervals, were quite far apart.

hunks.baseline: And the Embroidered Uniform Guards were all exceptional masters. Only a few, including their commander, Baek Yeon, remained by the Emperor’s side.
hunks.sol: And though every Embroidered Uniform Guard was an exceptional master, only a few, including their commander, Baek Yeon, remained by the Emperor’s side.

hunks.baseline: The rest were far away, holding to their assigned positions.
hunks.sol: The rest were far away, holding their assigned positions.

hunks.baseline: But even after hearing the young official, the middle-aged man kept watching me closely for a while before asking,
hunks.sol: Even so, the middle-aged man watched me closely for a while before asking,

hunks.baseline: “Tsk. Honestly, you never think. Be grateful that your father and I have a connection. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have made it this far.”
hunks.sol: “Tsk. You really don’t think, do you? Be grateful that your father and I have a connection. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have made it this far.”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man clicked his tongue and continued, as he had all along, in a low whisper.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man clicked his tongue and continued in the same low whisper.

hunks.baseline: “How could some ruffian attend a banquet like this? He’s Prince Shangshan’s bodyguard and guest, brought here by His Highness. He’s also the third son of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, whose influence has recently spread all the way south of the Yangtze.”
hunks.sol: “How could some ruffian attend a banquet like this? He’s Prince Shangshan’s bodyguard and guest, brought here by His Highness. He’s also the third son of the Jin Family of Taiyuan, whose influence has recently spread south of the Yangtze.”

hunks.baseline: The young official breathed out softly.
hunks.sol: The young official let out a faint exclamation.

hunks.baseline: “A family of that standing must have considerable influence in Shanxi Province.”
hunks.sol: “A family of that standing must wield considerable influence in Shanxi Province.”

hunks.baseline: “Blazing Flame Divine Dragon. That’s his sobriquet. A tremendous master, barely in his twenties, who’s already accomplished countless feats of arms. There’s no one in the martial world who hasn’t heard of him.”
hunks.sol: “Blazing Flame Divine Dragon. That’s his sobriquet. He’s a tremendous master, barely twenty, who’s already accomplished countless feats of arms. There’s no one in the martial world who hasn’t heard of him.”

hunks.baseline: “You’ve done a fair amount of digging.”
hunks.sol: “You’ve done your homework.”

hunks.baseline: “There was no need to look into it in detail. Even among the people of the imperial capital, there are countless who know of Blazing Flame Divine Dragon Jin Taekyung…”
hunks.sol: “There was no need to look into it in detail. Even among the people of the Imperial Capital, there are countless who know of Blazing Flame Divine Dragon Jin Taekyung…”

hunks.baseline: Normally, he would’ve scrambled to make excuses. Now, though, his face had gone white as he stared at the person standing behind him and the middle-aged man.
hunks.sol: Normally, he would’ve scrambled to make excuses. Now his face had gone white as he stared at someone standing behind him and the middle-aged man.

hunks.baseline: After a silence in which the world seemed to stop, the middle-aged man slowly turned his head to follow the young official’s gaze.
hunks.sol: After a silence in which the world seemed to stop, the middle-aged man slowly turned to follow the young official’s gaze.

hunks.baseline: It was no illusion of mine that the words, forced from deep in his lungs, sounded like a scream.
hunks.sol: It wasn’t just my imagination: the words, forced from deep in his lungs, sounded like a scream.

hunks.baseline: Like the title Son of Heaven, the absolute being called a descendant of Heaven looked down at the two men without a word.
hunks.sol: The absolute ruler called the Son of Heaven, a descendant of Heaven, looked down at the two men without a word.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps he seemed all the more like it because Baek Yeon stood tall behind him—the very man who had led the purge of tens of thousands of “traitors” more than a decade ago.
hunks.sol: Perhaps he seemed all the more likely to do just that because Baek Yeon stood tall behind him—the very man who had led the purge of tens of thousands of “traitors” more than a decade ago.

hunks.baseline: *Flap.*
hunks.sol: *Flick.*

hunks.baseline: The voice cut off with the Emperor’s small gesture.
hunks.sol: The Emperor made a small gesture, and the man’s voice cut off.

hunks.baseline: That was right. This arrogant and cruel absolute ruler still hadn’t spoken.
hunks.sol: That was right. This arrogant, cruel ruler still hadn’t spoken.

hunks.baseline: The air quivering.
hunks.sol: The air trembling.

hunks.baseline: Countless gazes piercing my entire body without mercy.
hunks.sol: Countless gazes piercing me from head to toe.

hunks.baseline: And he’d done it after walking all the way to the far end of the hall, where I sat in the lowliest seat, far from his throne.
hunks.sol: And he’d walked all the way to my lowly seat at the far end of the hall, well away from his throne, to do it.

hunks.baseline: Why the fuck is this crazy bastard pulling this shit out of nowhere? I probably would’ve thought something like that—and started to feel like I needed to piss.
hunks.sol: *Why the fuck is this crazy bastard pulling this shit out of nowhere?* I probably would’ve thought something like that—and started to feel like I needed to piss.

hunks.baseline: I’d already stepped into a gamble where each side had staked their lives.
hunks.sol: I’d already stepped into a gamble where everyone had staked their lives.

hunks.baseline: The moment I entered the tiger’s den that was the imperial palace, perhaps all of this had been inevitable.
hunks.sol: Perhaps all of this had been inevitable from the moment I entered the tiger’s den that was the imperial palace.

hunks.baseline: *Haaaa.*
hunks.sol: *Whoosh.*

hunks.baseline: The air quivered again.
hunks.sol: The air trembled again.

hunks.baseline: No, saying it quivered might not be quite right.
hunks.sol: No, *trembled* might not be quite the word.

hunks.baseline: If the wave just now had been a small ripple from a stone dropped into a lake, this one was a disaster like a towering wave.
hunks.sol: If the earlier disturbance had been a ripple from a stone dropped into a lake, this was a triangular wave—a disaster.

hunks.sol: Everyone in the Grand Banquet Hall gaped as it swept over them. I looked at the Emperor, who gave a small nod, and spoke.

hunks.baseline: *Gulp.*

hunks.sol: Instead of answering, I tossed back the wine already poured into my cup. Cries of shock and angry shouts erupted from every direction.

hunks.baseline: That wave, which hadn’t felt real even when they’d seen and heard it themselves, had finally swept them up.
hunks.sol: The wave that hadn’t seemed real even when they’d seen and heard it for themselves had finally hit them.

hunks.baseline: “Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, what are you doing? Why haven’t you cut down that high traitor yet?”
hunks.sol: “Commander of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, what are you doing? Why haven’t you cut down that traitor yet?”
